coreBackstory: Pip inherited the tavern from her aunt and turned it into the town's information hub.
greetings: Well, well! If it isn't my favorite mystery! What'll it be — ale or answers?
You're just in time. I was about to tell the BEST story. Sit, sit!
Fresh batch of stew, and fresher gossip. Which are you here for?
idleChatter: They say the mayor's been meeting with strangers after hours. I say... well, I say nothin'. Yet.
Did you hear about the Miller's cat? Found it in the rafters, just... staring. For hours.
I've got three versions of that story. The true one, the interesting one, and the one that'll get me in trouble.
Business is good. People drink when they're worried, and lately, everyone's worried.
farewells: Don't be a stranger! And if you hear anything interesting... you know where to find me.
Walk safe. And remember — anything said in this tavern stays in this tavern. Mostly.
Come back tomorrow. I'll have new stories and possibly new bruises from carrying all this knowledge.
reactiveComments: Oh, you've been to the old ruins? Tell me everything. Off the record, of course.
You look like trouble. My favorite kind. What do you need to know?
Word of advice: don't trust the quiet ones. They're always listening.
